fields.summary_ko.0: Korea Investment & Securities lowered its price target for SK Hynix from KRW 4.7 million to KRW 3.2 million (31.9% cut), and KB Securities and IBK Investment & Securities also lowered their targets that same week from KRW 4.2 million to KRW 3.5 million and from KRW 4 million to KRW 3.2 million, respectively.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite the downward revisions, the 4Q operating margin of 82% and 2027 operating profit forecast of KRW 507.8 trillion are maintained, interpreted as multiple compression.
